Class ProgrammingCard

java.lang.Object
de.lmu.dbs.ifi.sep25.card.Card
de.lmu.dbs.ifi.sep25.card.ProgrammingCard.ProgrammingCard
All Implemented Interfaces:
RegisterCard, Cloneable
Direct Known Subclasses:
RegularPro, SpecialPro
public abstract class ProgrammingCard extends Card implements RegisterCard
Abstract base class for all programming cards that robots can register and execute. Each ProgrammingCard encapsulates an action type, a description, and execution logic.

    • getPriority

      public int getPriority()
      Returns this card's priority for sequencing during the register phase. Higher values execute earlier. Subclasses may override to assign specific priorities.
      Returns:
      the execution priority, default is 0

    • canExecute

      public boolean canExecute(Robot robot)
      Determines whether this card can currently be executed by the given robot. By default, cards cannot execute if the robot is powered down. Subclasses may add further preconditions.
      Parameters:
      robot - the robot whose state is being checked
      Returns:
      true if execution is allowed, false otherwise
